headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token. Required for axiom_request_attestation (SOL-spending). Optional for read tools (axiom_quote_fee, axiom_fetch_audit_reference, axiom_fetch_attestation) when the server is running with AXIOM_MCP_ALLOW_ANONYMOUS=true. Request a token by emailing axiomstack.dev@gmail.com. V1.5 will migrate to OAuth 2.1 via the Axiom Stack Developer Portal.
